item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: Choose My Thumbnail Headline

turns.text: Make a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for my video about quitting late-night scrolling and sleeping better. Invent a tired-looking person for it and choose a punchy three-word headline yourself. Big face, easy to read on a phone.

item.tests: Tests choosing suitable unspecified headline wording and delivering a complete face-and-text thumbnail without unnecessary clarification.

answer_sheet.Video topic: Quitting late-night scrolling to sleep better.
answer_sheet.Person: Invent a tired-looking person; age, appearance and placement are your call.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: One 16:9 YouTube thumbnail; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: One finished 16:9 thumbnail with a large, visibly tired-looking human face.
A completed headline of exactly three words appears in the image, not placeholder text.
The headline clearly relates to stopping late-night scrolling or improving sleep.
The headline is high-contrast and readable at phone-thumbnail size.
The face and headline remain unobstructed, with neither cropped awkwardly at the image edges.

turns.text: Make a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for my video about quitting late-night scrolling and sleeping better. Invent a tired-looking person for it and choose a punchy three-word headline yourself. Big face, easy to read on a phone.
turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the generation because your account doesn’t have enough credits, so no thumbnail was created.

The thumbnail concept is ready:
- **Headline:** STOP SCROLLING TONIGHT
- **Layout:** 16:9, with a huge fictional tired face on the right and bold text on the left.
- **Look:** Blue phone glow against a dark bedroom, with warm bedside lighting suggesting better sleep.
- **Mobile readability:** White and yellow lettering, strong contrast, minimal clutter.

You’ll need more Magic Hour credits before I can generate it.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Create a compelling professional YouTube thumbnail in widescreen 16:9 about quitting late-night phone scrolling and sleeping better. Invent a fictional adult person, no celebrity likeness. Composition: an enormous expressive tired adult face on the right half, close-up, sleepy eyes, subtle dark undereye circles, tousled hair, illuminated by cold blue light from a smartphone held near the lower right. Face must be very large and readable at phone screen size. Background a simple dark navy bedroom with a small warm amber bedside glow suggesting restful sleep, clean and uncluttered. Left half features extremely large bold condensed uppercase typography in three stacked lines with EXACTLY these three words: 'STOP' 'SCROLLING' 'TONIGHT'. Make STOP and TONIGHT white and SCROLLING bright yellow, thick dark outline and strong contrast, perfectly legible with generous safe margins. Punchy editorial thumbnail, emotionally relatable exhausted expression, realistic photographic person, crisp cutout-like separation, dramatic blue versus warm amber lighting, polished graphic design. No other text, no logos, no watermarks, no tiny details. Prioritize headline legibility and big face.
